name: Evil's Media Encoding Platform
notes: Jellyfin setup is now easier: click Connect to Jellyfin, enter your server, username and password once, and EMP saves the returned access token automatically.
EMP never stores your Jellyfin password. It clears the password field immediately after a successful connection.
Existing Jellyfin API keys are still supported, so current setups keep working.
The same guided Jellyfin connection is available in Platform Builder and Settings.
Release notes are now written in plain language so users can see what each EMP update actually changes.
